name: hermes-personastudio
description: Persona Studio: a Hermes Desktop plugin. desktop/lib/persona-helpers.mjs is the importable, unit-tested source; scripts/build-plugin.mjs inlines it into desktop/dist/plugin.js because the desktop runtime loader only allows @hermes/plugin-sdk and react* imports.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && node scripts/check-imports.mjs desktop/dist/plugin.js && node --test tests/plugin.test.mjs
